_note: Provenance for the execution-free tau-bench floor of appendix C.3. The per-task predicates in tau_<env>_static_floor.jsonl are derived artifacts: regenerating them needs tau-bench installed, but checking the floor and the agreement figure against them does not. task_set_sha256 is the drift signal -- if upstream edits the task set it moves, and the recorded counts are stale rather than wrong. scripts/check_appendix_numbers.py verifies the counts offline.
